# wallix.bastion.externalauth_ldap

Manage LDAP external authentications on a WALLIX Bastion — module

*Added in version 1.1.0 of `wallix.bastion`.*

## Synopsis

- Create, update or delete an LDAP or Active Directory external authentication server on a WALLIX Bastion.
- Equivalent of the `wallix-bastion_externalauth_ldap` Terraform resource.
- Authentication domains that use the server are managed with their own modules.

| <a id="parameter-authentication-name"></a>**authentication_name** | `str` / required | Name of the external authentication. | <a id="parameter-private-key"></a>**private_key** | `str` | PEM private key of [`certificate`](#parameter-certificate). Use `""` to remove it.<br>The Bastion never returns it, so only whether it is set is compared. See [`update_password`](#parameter-update-password). |
| <a id="parameter-state"></a>**state** | `str` | Whether the external authentication should exist.<br><br>Choices: `present` (default), `absent` |
| <a id="parameter-timeout"></a>**timeout** | `float` | Timeout of the connection to the server, in seconds.<br>The `timeout` field of the API. [`timeout`](#parameter-timeout) is the timeout of the requests to the Bastion.<br>Required when the external authentication does not exist yet and [`state=present`](#parameter-state). |
| <a id="parameter-update-password"></a>**update_password** | `str` | `on_create` sends [`password`](#parameter-password), [`ca_certificate`](#parameter-ca-certificate), [`certificate`](#parameter-certificate), [`private_key`](#parameter-private-key) and [`passphrase`](#parameter-passphrase) only when the external authentication is created, or when one of them is set on one side only (set here and empty on the Bastion, or `""` here and set on the Bastion).<br>`always` sends the ones that are set on every run, which then always reports a change.<br><br>Choices: `always`, `on_create` (default) |
| <a id="parameter-use-primary-auth-domain"></a>**use_primary_auth_domain** | `bool` | Whether to use the primary authentication domain. |

## Attributes

| Attribute | Support | Description |
|---|---|---|
| **check_mode** | full | Can run in check_mode and return changed status prediction without modifying target. |
| **diff_mode** | full | Will return details on what has changed (or possibly needs changing in check_mode), when in diff mode. |

## Notes

- Options left unset keep their current value on the Bastion.
- The Bastion refuses to delete an external authentication that an authentication domain uses.
- The environment variables are the ones of the `wallix/wallix-bastion` Terraform provider, so one shell configuration serves both tools.
- Set the connection options once per play with `module_defaults` and the `group/wallix.bastion.bastion` action group.
- These modules call the Bastion API from the host they run on; use them with `delegate_to` or on a play targeting `localhost`.

## Examples

```yaml
- name: Declare an Active Directory server
  wallix.bastion.externalauth_ldap:
    authentication_name: corp-ad
    host: dc01.corp.example.com
    port: 636
    is_ssl: true
    is_active_directory: true
    timeout: 3
    ldap_base: dc=corp,dc=example,dc=com
    login_attribute: sAMAccountName
    cn_attribute: cn
    login: CN=svc-bastion,OU=Services,DC=corp,DC=example,DC=com
    password: "{{ vault_ad_bind_password }}"
    ca_certificate: "{{ lookup('ansible.builtin.file', 'corp-ca.pem') }}"

- name: Change the bind password
  wallix.bastion.externalauth_ldap:
    authentication_name: corp-ad
    password: "{{ vault_ad_new_bind_password }}"
    update_password: always

- name: Remove the LDAP server
  wallix.bastion.externalauth_ldap:
    authentication_name: corp-ad
    state: absent
```

## Return values

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="return-changed-fields"></a>**changed_fields** | `list / elements=str` | Options that differed from the Bastion and were updated. Contains the secret options that were sent when [`update_password=always`](#parameter-update-password).<br><br>Returned: when the external authentication already existed and [`state=present`](#parameter-state)<br><br>Sample: `["description", "password"]` |
| <a id="return-externalauth"></a>**externalauth** | `dict` | The external authentication as returned by the Bastion API after the change, without its secrets.<br>Certificates are returned as their subject.<br>In check mode, the expected external authentication. `null` when [`state=absent`](#parameter-state).<br><br>Returned: always<br><br>Sample: see [below](#sample-externalauth) |

<a id="sample-externalauth"></a>

### Sample of `externalauth`

```yaml
authentication_name: corp-ad
ca_certificate: /DC=com/DC=example/CN=Corp Root CA
certificate: ''
cn_attribute: cn
description: ''
grouping_id: ''
host: dc01.corp.example.com
id: 1a0f766ccb90205c005056b66c8b
is_active_directory: true
is_anonymous_access: false
is_protected_user: false
is_ssl: true
is_starttls: false
ldap_base: dc=corp,dc=example,dc=com
login: CN=svc-bastion,OU=Services,DC=corp,DC=example,DC=com
login_attribute: sAMAccountName
port: 636
timeout: 3.0
type: LDAP
url: https://bastion.example.com/api/v3.12/externalauths/1a0f766ccb90205c005056b66c8b
use_primary_auth_domain: false
```
